label: Definition from SNR
subgoals: Divide input SNR by output SNR at a 290 K source
Convert the factor to dB for the noise figure
Write F as one plus the added noise over the source noise

label: Noise temperature
subgoals: Define Te as the extra source temperature that matches the added noise
Compute Te as F minus one times 290 K
Use noise temperature for very low-noise systems

label: Sensitivity of a receiver
subgoals: Start from minus 174 dBm per hertz
Add ten log ten of the bandwidth, the noise figure and the required SNR
Use periodic noise analysis for frequency-translating blocks
